challenge.scenario: Two tabs save same draft revision concurrently.
challenge.finding: Last writer may overwrite first unless expectedRevision comparison is atomic.
challenge.resolution: Preserve canonical expectedRevision and row lock and require future actual race test.

challenge.scenario: An autosave arrives with stale expectedRevision.
challenge.finding: Older text silently replaces newer user edits.
challenge.resolution: Require OFFICE_DRAFT_REVISION_CONFLICT and compare saved revision before mutation.

challenge.scenario: A browser attempts to edit draft id from another webshop.
challenge.finding: SECURITY DEFINER could modify cross-tenant data if checks omitted.
challenge.resolution: Canonical instance id and author private checks, later runtime negative test.

challenge.scenario: A support actor tries writing another user draft.
challenge.finding: Unauthorized content or recipient edits leak.
challenge.resolution: Preserve author_user_id equality and support/compose permission.

challenge.scenario: An autosave fires on each keystroke/debounce cycle.
challenge.finding: Audit table flooding and high costs if every autosave is audited.
challenge.resolution: Preserve canonical manual-vs-autosave branch without per-debounce audit.

challenge.scenario: A new draft has no expectedRevision or draft ID.
challenge.finding: Overrestrictive conflict logic can block creation.
challenge.resolution: Revision required only for existing draft; default 1 on insert.

challenge.scenario: A draft row has revision 0 or NULL.
challenge.finding: Nonpositive revisions cause optimistic comparisons to misbehave.

challenge.scenario: A server worker supplies forged p_actor to service_role draft RPC.
challenge.finding: Caller impersonation possible even if SQL compares p_actor to draft owner.
challenge.resolution: Treat source-proof as partial and require server identity binding.
